title: README.md#Self-improvement loop chunk 1
summary: After each session, Zonoid mines the completed task graph and agent transcripts for reusable patterns — architectural decisions, gotchas, constraints — and queues them for LLM evaluation. Accepted candidates are injected as knowledge notes into the graph. Future sessions inherit those notes as Tier-1 context via search_knowledge and suggest_links, so the agent starts each run with the accumulated findings of every prior session rather than a blank slate.
